description: Months of gross profit needed to earn back the cost of acquiring a customer: CAC / (monthly revenue per account x gross margin). Give cac_usd directly, or sales_marketing_spend_usd and new_customers for the same period. Many SaaS investors look for roughly 12 to 18 months or less, shorter for SMB. Use ltv_cac to also see lifetime value. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/unit-economics-early-stage-startups

arpa_monthly_usd.description: Average revenue per account per month.

cac_usd.description: Cost to acquire one customer. Optional if spend and new customers are given.

new_customers.description: New customers won in the same period.

sales_marketing_spend_usd.description: Sales and marketing spend in the period (used with new_customers when cac_usd is not given).

name: cac_payback
title: CAC payback period
